description: The jabberwock defined VOICE as the operator that generates a speaker analysis-paths — the invariant left when you quotient out the passage. Built over many passages as a centroid+spread (figure-histogram, stance baseline, opposition-habit); an unsigned passage is attributed to the nearest voice, with separation (intra<inter) the test of a good model.

attrs.name: authorial_voice
attrs.description: The order-N operation ABOVE analysis: a figure is a displacement vector, an analysis is the path those vectors trace through one passage, and a VOICE is the OPERATOR that generates paths — the invariant transform a speaker applies to whatever topic they touch. It is one order higher because it is what remains when you QUOTIENT OUT the passage: factor out aboutness and the consistent manner of displacing is the voice. Analysis: where does this passage go; voice: how does this speaker always bend meaning, regardless of where they start.

attrs.name: voice_signature
attrs.description: The output: a Voice node = a CENTROID over many of a speaker analyses — figure-preference histogram, stance/valence baseline, register vector, displacement-shape signature (magnitude/curvature), and opposition-habit — kept with its SPREAD (a voice is partly its consistency: covariances not means), linked by voiced_by edges to its evidence passages.

attrs.name: voice_attribution
attrs.head: voice
attrs.body: attribute an unsigned passage by running its analysis, projecting it into the same axes, and taking the nearest Voice centroid weighted by that voice spread (Mahalanobis); emit only if it beats the next-best by a margin, else mint a candidate new voice rather than force a fit

attrs.name: voice_predicts
attrs.head: voice
attrs.body: a good voice-model predicts: held-out passages by the same speaker land inside its spread (low intra-voice distance) while different speakers separate cleanly (high inter-voice distance)

attrs.name: voice_is_generative
attrs.head: voice
attrs.body: the sharper test is generative — a good voice lets you predict the figure a speaker will reach for on a new topic; parody is the proof: displace a neutral passage along the voice signature and it should read as that speaker
